title: A fixed number of workers
hints: Starting one goroutine per item lets the concurrency grow without limit. A pool starts exactly `workers` goroutines that all take jobs from one channel.
Send the indexes 0..len(items)-1 on a jobs channel and close it. Each worker ranges over jobs and writes results[i] = f(items[i]). Wait for the workers with a WaitGroup.

jobs := make(chan int); go func() { defer close(jobs); for i := range items { jobs <- i } }(); for range workers { wg.Add(1); go func() { defer wg.Done(); for i := range jobs { results[i] = f(items[i]) } }() }; wg.Wait()
